overall_assessment: The Sourceright extraction strategy and compatibility adapter framework codified across migration/sourceright/replacement-map.yaml, migration/sourceright/parity-cases.json, crates/searchright-sourceright-compat/src/lib.rs, crates/searchright-sourceright-compat/src/parity_matrix.rs, crates/searchright-sourceright-compat/tests/parity_matrix.rs, migration/companion-repositories/sourceright.json, and integration/release-train.json provides an exemplary, reversible migration pathway. All Sourceright provider surfaces (fetch_json, apply_provider_interval, read_cached, write_cached, smoke reports) are mapped to core equivalents with defined deprecation timelines. Crucially, the companion repository packet (migration/companion-repositories/sourceright.json) enforces remote_mutation_permitted: false, preventing premature downstream code removal or unreviewed SemVer breakage until dual-run parity is evidenced. All 30 migration and local API tests pass cleanly.
verified_invariants: Comprehensive replacement mapping: migration/sourceright/replacement-map.yaml maps all legacy symbols to evidence-search-core equivalents
Parity execution matrix: v2 parity catalogue and matrix schemas validate 10 declared parity dimensions
Fail-closed companion change packet: migration/companion-repositories/sourceright.json disallows unreviewed remote mutations
Non-breaking compatibility adapter: searchright-sourceright-compat provides seamless bridge during transition

findings.description: Compatibility contracts, replacement maps, and local parity execution matrices are verified; executing old/new dual runs downstream in Sourceright remains an open operational gate.
findings.recommendation: Preserve open gate for downstream Sourceright dual-run verification.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Inventory of Sourceright live_providers and provider modules verified.
Compatibility adapter and feature flag structure verified.
Parity cases, v2 parity execution matrix, and snapshot diffing contracts verified.
Reversible switch plan and companion change packet fail-closed configuration verified.

limitations: Extraction contracts and compatibility adapters verified; live downstream Sourceright cutover and code deletion remain separate release-train operations.
